About:

Travis Marziani breaks down exactly how to book a free one-on-one Amazon strategy call and what to expect from the Passion Product Accelerator program — including real student results and Travis's own success selling on Amazon.

- Travis launched Carnivore Electrolytes in seven days as a YouTube challenge and grew it from 3 sales a day to nearly 100 sales a day
- Carnivore Electrolytes generated over one million dollars in revenue and around $400,000–$500,000 in profit before Travis sold the business for $840,000
- The business ran as passive income with just one hour of work per week — mainly reordering inventory
- Real student success stories: Calvin made $400K in his first year, Juliana made $100K as a first-time seller, and Brent hit $1 million in sales
- Students AJ, Jeremy, Andrew, and Carla are highlighted as standout examples of what's possible selling on Amazon
- The free strategy call covers how to find a product you're passionate about, build a niche brand, launch on Amazon step by step, and eventually sell the business
- The Passion Product Accelerator offers one-on-one calls, pre-recorded training, accountability, and hands-on guidance built from Travis Marziani's 10 years of selling on Amazon
- Travis personally reviews applications to ensure the call is only offered to people with a strong chance of success

Travis Marziani shares everything he's learned over a decade of building and selling Amazon businesses — from picking a passion-based product and building a brand, to generating passive income and selling for life-changing money through the Passion Product Accelerator.
